_why: The sha256 of each launchd template's NORMAL FORM (see greymatter/plist_normalise.py), and the migration decision taken when that form last changed. Changing a template semantically shuts the legacy adoption window for every machine that has not adopted yet: update the hash AND say here what happens to them. tests/launchd_template_migration.py goes red otherwise.

com.greymatter.machiniste.plist.template.migration_decision: renamed in v2.1.0, 2026-09-27 (the pre-rename names are quoted on purpose): the label com.claudebrain.X became com.greymatter.X and the paths ~/.c-brain became ~/.greymatter (the old root stays as a link). Machines that have not adopted: install.sh retires an old-label job only when it is on record as its own; an unrecorded one is left running, its new twin is not installed, and the installer says how to stop it. tests/update_across_rename.sh replays the recorded case.
